claims.statement: medication lists should include prescriptions, nonprescription medicines, vitamins and supplements; names, strengths, purpose, instructions, allergies and emergency contacts; lists should be updated and shared with caregivers and health professionals.
locators: B05-S01 main text: list fields and review/update/share paragraphs
B05-S02 main text: up-to-date written list, allergies, sharing and ability to take medicines
claims.handling: Product concept addresses this coordination need; screen content and usability are invented demonstrations, not validated outcomes.

claims.statement: All people, medications, quantities, permissions, pharmacy and clinic records are fictional demo content.
claims.handling: No claim of clinical appropriateness, diagnosis, real adoption or measured benefit.
